title: RAGAS meta-evaluation v1
description: `<answers>_ragas.json`, written by `eval score ragas` (and by `answers generate --ragas`): RAGAS metric scores of the answers, with and without the retrieved documents. The writer owns the metric shape; only the envelope and the schema version are checked here.

run_id.description: The envelope: the id of the run that saved this file (dokimi.artifacts.run_id). Absent from files saved before the envelope.

dokimi_version.description: The envelope: the dokimi version that saved this file. Absent from files saved before the envelope.

ragas_summary.description: Mean RAGAS metrics per condition: `with_docs` and `without_docs`.

ragas_per_question.description: Per-question RAGAS scores per condition: `with_docs` and `without_docs`.

ragas_model.description: The judge that scored the answers, `provider/model`, as `eval score ragas` ran it (`--ragas-provider`, `--ragas-model`). Absent from files saved before it was recorded.
